notes.title: Long time no see.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/88b9d0664932a9aafc1cd022f71eeb5efe82e36b.png[/img]
[i]It's been quite some time since we saw each other,
let me tell you what has changed...[/i]

[h3]GRAPHICAL ENHANCEMENT OF THE WORLD[/h3]
We try to make 8874 world even more immersive and magical by adding new graphical effects and enriching the environment. 

[b]Volumetric fog[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/4a466fc5161f242c8e5db84355f22fd622edf510.png[/img]

[b]Improoved Viktor's room[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/86f4e07b5bf991b926d60b28e7147f0798c8eadf.png[/img]
(there are some easter eggs hidden here and there🤫, working on adding some more)

[h3]NEW UNDERGROUND AREAS[/h3]
We added new areas beneath the ground the whole WWII bunker network for you to explore, as well as some "ancient" underground tunnels.

[b]New places[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/1e85401dfa62818d6c0c368e605f1076c2508a38.png[/img]

[b]Underground traps[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/c874eb151f3bed8b7d978146d147990bd829bd7d.png[/img]

[i]Won't tell you more, for now, to keep you insatiable and let your imagination fill the gaps. 
This time it won't be this long till we see again
Promise...
[/i]

notes.title: After the Demo.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/bc0607e04e844488d963fda674312d8af9e5b2d1.png[/img]

[h3]All good things must come to an end, 
so does Steam Next Fest and 8874 Demo.[/h3]

[b]We looked through the feedback and thanks to you guys we know what to improve/change: [/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Double jump[/b] - the most disliked mechanic is going back to the sketch board. 
We thought of making the height and the length of the jump dependent on the momentum, or the length of the jump key press. 
[*] [b]Wiktor's Home[/b]- we'll think about cutting the animation time after death, additionally, some things will be added there, to diversify the experience. At home, you'll be able to see various items collected during your adventure too. 
[*] [b]Running [/b]- we'll think about lowering character speed a bit and adding a dedicated run button (will help to solve the double jump problem)
[*] [b]Jumping sound[/b] - the distracting sound will be changed 
[/list]
Of course, we'll be adding a lot of new content before release, as well as doing loads of bug fixing.

Right now it's time to get back to work,
[i]till the next time...[/i]

notes.title: Gamers, assemble! We need your support!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/2e02086af27c0bd148e16aff321cbb7d41bec17c.png[/img]

[h3]Don’t adjust your screens and refresh the browsers or Steam clients!  
You’re seeing well, this devlog is about something totally different than usual![/h3]

On the occasion of the ongoing campaign on Kickstarter, we’re helping our brother, [b]Climber: Sky is the Limit[/b], get some well-deserved attention! 


Our studio, together with A2 Softworks, didn’t expect the project to be nominated in 2 categories on such prestige event as [b]gamescom 2021[/b]. Nominations gave us a lot of motivation, and fuel for future development but like in every game cycle, there is a time when developers need some help from their community. 

This time has come for us, that’s why we would like to invite you all to Climber: Sky is the Limit’s campaign on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/climberskyisthelimit/climber-sky-is-the-limit]KICKSTARTER[/url]! 

For the next few weeks on Kickstarter, we’re going to collect funds and feedback from the gamers to polish the game and astonish everyone with its final form! 

At this stage of development, all help is welcomed. That’s why if you can’t (or don’t want to) help us through Kickstarter but you’re willing to support us in any form, even a small action like leaving feedback or adding the game to your wishlist on Steam will help us a million! 


[b]Follow the project’s campaign on Kickstarter and get notified at launch![/b]

notes.title: Places and locations.
notes.content:
[i]Gather around the bonfire, get warm. 
Time for another story.
This time we will dwell on the places that you'll travel through during your journey...[/i]

[h3]Pełcznica Gorge[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/918f8fa84e63e6c1bff0ae90d40b9cee9e5cabd7.png[/img]

Picturesque mountain scenery mixed with dense forests.  
Strange marks on the trees symbolize things long forgotten by people, only the oldest locals may know their meaning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/82fba2def45ef3eb56657b59c3a04e9a13c00793.png[/img]

I feel like someone or something is watching your every move here, maybe you'll be able to figure out his/theirs intentions if you dare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/7c3607b5c9ba2523cae03d7e3e979ee66959260c.png[/img]

[h3]Książ Castle's Underground Tunnels[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/62d7541df948da5bda30102d22b465fda89cf050.png[/img]

At some point, you'll find yourself beneath the ground, traveling through the dark and deep tunnels carved under the Książ Castle by people living there a long time ago, then extended by nazis during WWII. 
God knows what you'll find there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/6cd3aee89a120dc7f1cbad2b446146c120ae6324.png[/img]
[b]Family portraits guarding dark secrets?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/5b62a861e06114080e3de6117f46b287a4e9e9d9.png[/img]
[b]Forbidden riches of the 3rd reich?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/cd1112f64d313a65c80d9b4a66865d09e5919c17.png[/img]
[b]or just old paintings?[/b]

All of that is for you to discover, but be warry some things are better left buried underground...

[h3]The Giants Grave[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/3cd6f2f596eacb1c8c5c52fd04553f0eadbfbed0.png[/img]

As some of you might know by now, centuries ago the Giants inhabited the earth. One of their keepsakes is The Giants Grave located near the Książ Castle. 
Allegedly, people are hearing voices coming from the mountain named after the giant. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/3cdd9261af0ffcade1493ba109a1fe5db94609bd.png[/img]

Some people think the Giant was buried alive...


[i]The fire is fading out, 
It's time to go. 
When we meet again, 
we will share something big with you.[/i]
